description:
## [1.2.1](https://github.com/mirbyte/morphe-patches/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1) (2026-11-08)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Accept Bloomberg Play Store versionName for v6.66.0 ([0023e11](https://github.com/mirbyte/morphe-patches/commit/0023e11964f809cea0d1e1917e90291125ae8962))

patches.name: Clone Bloomberg
patches.description: Changes the package name to com.bloomberg.android.plus.morphe so the app installs next to the Play Store version. Renames custom permissions and provider authorities to match. Makes updating easier as you can get the original APK from Play Store.

patches.name: Disable analytics SDKs
patches.description: Turns off AppsFlyer (install tracking and event logging) and Comscore (audience measurement). AppsFlyer does not start, and events it logs report success without being sent. Comscore sends no startup, foreground, view, or stream pings.

patches.name: Disable manifest telemetry
patches.description: Disables Firebase and Google Analytics collection flags, Sentry and Facebook SDK collection flags, the ad ID and install referrer permissions, and the Google Analytics, Measurement, and Sentry components in AndroidManifest.xml.

patches.name: Force subscription and disable ads
patches.description: Hides ad components, ad slots, and banner ads, and makes the app report an active device subscription.

patches.name: Remove Japanese fonts
patches.description: Removes the NotoSansJP font files from assets/fonts to save space.

patches.name: Rename Bloomberg
patches.description: Changes the launcher name shown under the app icon.

options.description: Name shown under the app icon on the home screen.

patches.name: Skip video ads
patches.description: Skips Google dynamic ad insertion for on-demand videos and plays the backup stream instead, when the stream provides one. Fixes video streams that do not play.

patches.name: Strip Bloomberg permissions
patches.description: Removes the selected permission groups from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.description: Removes RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED. Background work will not restart after a reboot.
Removes AD_ID and the ACCESS_ADSERVICES_* permissions. Blocks advertising ID access.
Removes BIND_GET_INSTALL_REFERRER_SERVICE. Blocks reading the install referrer.
Removes com.android.vending.BILLING. Breaks in-app purchases and subscriptions.

patches.name: Disable AdMob
patches.description: Makes the AdMob availability check return false.

patches.name: Disable GoPro ad fallback
patches.description: Disables the GoPro promo fallback triggered by AdMob load failures.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Drops analytics, tracking, and funnel events.

patches.name: Disable brokers feature
patches.description: Turns off the brokers feature toggle, which broker trading entry points on charts, watchlist, and alerts check.

patches.name: Force local Pro plan
patches.description: Forces the local plan lookup and plan state to report Pro. Also hides the profile upsell banner.

patches.name: Hide broker UI
patches.description: Hides broker entry points: the Explore Brokers block, the brokers banner and have-account prompt, the More menu's Trade with your broker button, and the trading and up/down arrows buttons below the chart.

patches.name: Hide profile upsell banner
patches.description: Hides the subscription upsell banner below the profile on the Menu tab. Also hidden by Force local Pro plan.

patches.name: Holy larp
patches.description: Forces the Ultimate badge on the current user. Visual only.

patches.name: Strip permissions
patches.description: Removes the selected permission groups from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.description: Removes FOREGROUND_SERVICE and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC. May break features that run as foreground services.
Removes RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED. Background work will not restart after a reboot.
Removes AD_ID and the ACCESS_ADSERVICES_* permissions. Blocks advertising ID access.
Removes com.android.vending.BILLING. Breaks in-app purchases and subscriptions.
